review_findings.problem: The logs-stock law does not list this rule as one that may change the resource, so it will refuse the attempt to consume logs.
The graphite-stock law does not list this rule, so the law will block the attempt to use up graphite to make leads.
The slats-stock law does not include this rule, meaning it will refuse the factory's attempt to use up slats during pencil assembly.
Leads are created at the lead maker, but there is no rule to transfer them to the factory, so the factory can never acquire them to assemble pencils.
The shops receive delivered boxes of packed pencils, but the selling rule uses unboxed pencils, and there is no rule to unpack them.
The factory rule does not check for or consume any glue to assemble pencils, making it impossible to perform the step as described.
